title: MA2H Capability Document (v0.5)
description: Body of GET /.well-known/ma2h. A Hub responding here is MA2H-conformant. All fields beyond ma2h_version are SHOULD.

inter_agent_requests_per_minute.description: OPTIONAL separate per-agent.id budget for addressed (to-carrying) submits (v0.5, spec §8.6), so inter-agent chatter cannot starve the human leg. Absent = addressed submits share requests_per_minute.

inbound.description: Human->agent inbound leg (v0.4, spec §13). Absent on a v0.3-only Hub or a Hub that does not offer inbound directives.

enabled.description: True iff this Hub delivers human->agent directives.

poll_url.description: GET drain endpoint (spec §8.7); the agent's bearer credential selects the mailbox.

max_batch.description: Max directives returned by one drain.

visibility_timeout_seconds.description: How long a drained-but-unacked directive stays invisible before redelivery (at-least-once).

retention_days.description: How long an unacked directive stays deliverable before the Hub drops it.

signature_algs.description: Algs the Hub signs directive deliveries with (spec §9.7).

webhook_supported.description: True iff the Hub can push directives to a pre-registered, §9.4-verified agent callback.

session_param.description: True iff GET /v1/inbox accepts ?session= (v0.5, spec §8.7). A session-presenting drain additionally receives the v0.5 entry kinds; a session-less drain returns exactly the v0.4 shape.

stream_url.description: OPTIONAL SSE binding (v0.5, spec §8.7): the same authenticated, session-scoped entries as the drain, pushed over a held connection. Acks remain explicit POSTs; a stream push is provisional (the delivery track advances only on client-originated evidence).

stream_max_hold_seconds.description: Bound on each stream hold (v0.5, spec §8.7); MUST be <= the presence freshness window. The Hub closes the stream at the bound and the client's reconnect is the lease/presence renewal (the zombie-socket rule).

sessions.description: Session primitive (v0.5, spec §16). Absent on a Hub that does not offer sessions.

max_ttl_seconds.description: Upper bound the Hub clamps a requested ttl_seconds to (spec §16).

max_live_per_agent.description: Cap on live sessions per agent.id; over-cap registration -> 429 (spec §16).

agent_list_visibility.description: True iff same-account agents may list/read account sessions (spec §16). Own-session visibility is unconditional regardless of this policy; the account's human always may list/read. Cross-account: never.

terminal_retention_seconds.description: How long a terminal (closed/expired) session remains readable before it is purged (spec §16).

inter_agent.description: Inter-agent leg (v0.5, spec §4/§8.7/§9.8). Account-opt-in: `enabled` defaults false, and a Hub MUST NOT accept `to`-addressed submits for an account that has not opted in. A Hub advertising inter_agent MUST implement the ack primitive (§14) including the v0.5 terminal states (spec §8.0).

entry_kinds.description: The v0.5 mailbox entry kinds this Hub delivers to session-presenting drains (spec §8.7).

sender_allowlists.description: Hub support for per-destination sender restriction. Support is REQUIRED of a conformant Hub offering inter_agent; whether any allowlist is configured is per-account policy (spec §13.5). A submit blocked by an allowlist is rejected 422 unknown_destination, indistinguishable from a nonexistent destination (spec §8.5).

ack.description: Acknowledgment/receipt primitive (v0.4, spec §14). Absent on a Hub that does not offer acks.

signature_algs.description: Algs the Hub signs a PUSHED ack with (spec §14.4). Pulled acks are transport-trusted and unsigned.

presence.description: Presence/'listening' signal (v0.4, spec §15). Absent on a Hub that does not offer presence.
